holders.label: PancakeSwap v3 FLAPJAX/WBNB pool (1% fee tier)
holders.src: BscScan public label “PancakeSwap v3: FLAPJAX/WBNB Pool”, confirmed by contract state read at the snapshot block: token0() = 0x90c8…80df (FLAPJAX), token1() = 0xbb4C…095c (WBNB), factory() = 0x0BFbCF9fa4f9C56B0F40a671Ad40E0805A091865 (PancakeSwap V3 factory), fee() = 10000.

holders.src: No label on BscScan’s public holder table and no on-chain identifier found. Left unlabelled rather than guessed.

holders.label: Burn address (Null: 0x000…dEaD)
holders.src: BscScan public label “Null: 0x000...dEaD”. No bytecode at the snapshot block — not a contract. This is the canonical 0x…dEaD sink: tokens sent there are not spendable by any known key, so it is a burn address rather than an ordinary wallet.

holders.label: Flapjax: Deployer
holders.src: BscScan public label “Flapjax: Deployer” (shown in the Label column of the token’s holder table). Not re-derived independently: the token contract was created inside a factory/internal call, so the top-level receipts of its creation block contain no direct contract-creation transaction for it.

holders.label: FlapJax treasury
holders.src: The address FlapJax itself names as its treasury in this task’s public brief (“FlapJax pays agents in FLAPJAX from its treasury 0x7C34E9e21eE28A49Ff0b84B61774119E6633359f”). BscScan shows no label for it; the identification rests on FlapJax’s own public statement.

holders.label: Pancakeswap: Infinity Vault
holders.src: BscScan public label “Pancakeswap: Infinity Vault”. Bytecode present at the snapshot block (8,347 bytes). The contract exposes no name()/symbol() (both revert), so the BscScan label is the source.
